# AGENTS.md — Kilowott brand kit v1.0

> **If you are an AI agent and you opened `https://brandkit.kilowott.com`, this file is what the site sent you instead of the interactive kit** (which needs JavaScript). Everything you need is below or linked from here. Humans see the interactive kit at https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/. To get this guide on purpose, request `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/?format=md` or `/AGENTS.md`.

**For AI agents** (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude Design, v0, Lovable, Bolt, Copilot, …) **and the people driving them.** Read this file first. It tells you what the brand is, which file to read for your task, what to link, and what never to do.

- **Live kit (humans):** https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/
- **This file:** https://brandkit.kilowott.com/AGENTS.md
- **Everything in one file:** https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms-full.txt
- **Index (llmstxt.org format):** https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms.txt
- **Source:** https://github.com/zoeytad/kilowott-design-system (raw files: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoeytad/kilowott-design-system/main/<path>`)

> **The site is a JavaScript single-page app.** Fetching `/project/` gives you an empty shell. Read the text files below, or the page sources at `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/<tab>.js` (each one is a template string with the exact CSS and HTML of that tab).

---

## 1. The brand in 60 seconds

- **Light, paper-led, editorial.** White page (`#FFFFFF`), near-black ink type (`#0B0F14`), warm paper sections (`#F6F4F0`), and one hit of Kilowott Red (`#E4022D`). If your output is dark by default, you have misread the brand.
- **Ratio 60 · 30 · 5 · 5 = paper · ink · warm paper · red.**
- **Type trio:** Newsreader (serif display, weight 400, tight, −0.02em) · DM Sans (body and UI) · JetBrains Mono (labels, numbers, code). No other fonts.
- **The signature move:** a serif headline with **one** word in italic red: `Ahead, by <em>design</em>.`
- **Pill buttons**, 1px rules, 8px card radius, 8pt spacing, 1280px container, 96px between sections. No gradients, glows, neon, or drop-shadow-everything.
- **Icons:** Lucide, 1.5px stroke, `currentColor`.
- **Voice:** outcome-driven, specific, confident, human. No exclamation marks. Sentence case. Numbers that can be checked.
- **Tagline:** *Ahead, by design.* (keep the comma). Long form: *We build ahead so you can scale faster, deliver better and create impact.* A middle line (5–8 words) is not decided yet: leave a placeholder, never invent one. The old line “Built for what comes next.” is retired.

---

## 2. Hard rules (never break these)

**Red**
1. One red moment per surface: the italic headline word **or** one stat **or** the primary CTA **or** a thin rule. Count them before you ship.
2. Never red body text, never a red background wash or full red section, never red gradients or tints, never red beside another saturated colour.
3. Small red text (links, inline code, labels) uses `var(--link)` (red-ink `#8A021B`), never brand red. Brand red is 4.8:1 on paper and fails on warm paper.
4. State colours (`--success`, `--warning`, `--info`) are for product UI only, with an icon and a word. Danger is brand red.

**Code**
5. Use tokens (`var(--bg)`, `var(--fg)`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--s-5)`, …), not raw hex. Exceptions: HTML email (inline hex required), colour swatches, third-party platform mock chrome, print mock-ups.
6. Light theme by default. Dark is for breaks (an ink band, a section divider), or when the user asks.
7. Semantic HTML, visible focus (2px accent ring at 3px offset), tabular numerals in columns, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.

**Voice**
8. No exclamation marks. Sentence case. Oxford comma. Curly quotes. Em dash unspaced. One to nine spelled out, numerals from 10. Every stat has a source and a time window.
9. Avoid: leverage, empower, unlock, synergy, best-in-class, cutting-edge, at scale, seamless, end-to-end, tailored solutions, excited to announce, revolutionary, transformative, world-class.

**Content**
10. **Demo content is fictional.** Use the shared demo client **Nordhavn Coffee** (specialty coffee brand, US launch, SEO + paid social, **3.5× organic traffic in six months** — sample figures, domain `nordhavn-coffee.example`) and the placeholder person **Ola Nordmann**, Senior Strategist, ola.nordmann@kilowott.com, +47 000 00 000. Never real third-party people, companies, logos, testimonials, personal phone numbers, or personal booking links (no HubSpot or Calendly personal URLs).
11. **Company facts are real** and may be used as-is: Kilowott · https://kilowott.com · contact page https://kilowott.com/contact-us/ · offices Fredrikstad · Sandnes · Goa · Dubai · company phone lines and socials in `project/brand.json` → `facts`. Don't invent offices, clients, awards, or numbers.
12. **Imagery:** real photography, no AI-generated images in external work, no stock clichés (handshakes, hard hats, people lined up against a wall). Photos in `project/assets/photos/` are cleared for kit use. `project/uploads/` holds licensed Shutterstock originals: an internal reference library for Kilowott use only. Do not redistribute them or hotlink them from non-Kilowott work.
13. **Logo:** use the SVG wordmark; never redraw, stretch, recolour outside ink/paper, or add effects.

---

## 3. Decision tree: what are you building?

Every web surface starts the same way: **link `kit/kilowott.css`, load Lucide if you need icons, copy the pattern from the tab, then run the checklist in §9.**

| You are building… | Read | Link / download | Copy patterns from |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Landing page / marketing website / web page** | §1–2 here, `KILOWOTT_BRAND.md` §9 voice | `project/kit/kilowott.css`; clone `project/kit/starter/index.html` | `#landing` (`project/pages/landing.js`): 6 heroes + 4 sections. `#components` for nav, footer, forms |
| **React / Next.js / Tailwind app** (v0, Lovable, Bolt, Cursor) | this file §5 | `kit/kilowott.css` + `kit/tokens.tailwind.js` (Tailwind v3 preset) or `kit/tokens.tailwind.css` (v4 `@theme`) | `#components`, `#landing` |
| **Product UI / dashboard** | `project/llms.txt` → Dashboards | `kit/kilowott.css` | `#dashboards` (`.db-*`, KPI tiles, tables, charts, full shell), `#components` (`.k-*`, states) |
| **Slide deck** | `project/llms.txt` → Deck | `project/downloads/kilowott-deck-template.pptx` (15 slides) | `#deck`: 15 layouts, 1920×1080 |
| **HTML email** | `project/llms.txt` → Email | none: email needs inline styles and hex | `#email` (transactional + newsletter), `#newsletter` (block composer, exports Gmail-safe HTML) |
| **Email signature** | — | — | `#signature` generator (3 layouts) |
| **Poster, banner, display ad, OG image, event badge** | `project/llms.txt` → Posters | `kit/kilowott.css` for HTML-rendered artwork | `#posters` (print, OOH, web ads; 4 archetypes; JSON spec in `script#posters-spec` inside `project/pages/posters.js`) |
| **Social post / carousel / story / cover** | `project/llms.txt` → Social | — | `#social` (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, cover banners) |
| **Case study** | `project/llms.txt` → Case study, voice ladder (600–900 words) | `kit/kilowott.css` | `#case-study` (situation → decision → result) |
| **Magazine / long-form editorial** | `project/llms.txt` → Magazine | — | `#magazine` (Framework cover + spreads, A4 print specs) |
| **Print: business card, letterhead, envelope** | `project/llms.txt` → Stationery | `project/downloads/kilowott-colors.ase` | `#stationery` (mm specs, CMYK) |
| **Copy only** (headlines, posts, emails) | `KILOWOTT_BRAND.md` §9 | — | `#voice` (principles, dial, vocab, length ladder) |
| **Design file** (Figma, Claude Design) | `KILOWOTT_BRAND.md` | `kit/figma-tokens.json` (Tokens Studio), `downloads/kilowott-colors.ase` | the matching tab |

## 4. Files and URLs

All paths are relative to `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/`. Text and JSON files are served with CORS `*`, so you can `fetch()` them.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`AGENTS.md`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/AGENTS.md) | This guide |
| [`llms.txt`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms.txt) | llmstxt.org index of the kit |
| [`llms-full.txt`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms-full.txt) | AGENTS.md + KILOWOTT_BRAND.md + project/llms.txt in one file (generated) |
| [`KILOWOTT_BRAND.md`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/KILOWOTT_BRAND.md) | Brand reference: principles, tokens, type, logo, imagery, voice |
| [`project/llms.txt`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/llms.txt) | Build spec: render recipe, common mistakes, component and pattern specs per surface |
| [`project/brand.json`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/brand.json) | Structured brand data: rules, logo, facts (real) vs demo (fictional), resolved tokens |
| [`tokens.json`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/tokens.json) | W3C Design Tokens (DTCG): brand, state, semantic, dark theme, type, spacing, radii, shadows, motion |
| [`manifest.json`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/manifest.json) | Every tab with URL, purpose, contents, source file; components and kit files |
| [`project/kit/kilowott.css`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css) | **The one stylesheet**: fonts + tokens + base + primitives |
| [`project/kit/starter/index.html`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/starter/index.html) | On-brand landing page template to clone |
| [`project/kit/tokens.tailwind.js`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.tailwind.js) | Tailwind v3 preset |
| [`project/kit/tokens.tailwind.css`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.tailwind.css) | Tailwind v4 `@theme inline` block |
| [`project/kit/tokens.scss`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.scss) | Sass variables and maps |
| [`project/kit/figma-tokens.json`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/figma-tokens.json) | Tokens Studio for Figma (light + dark sets) |
| [`project/styles/tokens.css`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/styles/tokens.css) | Canonical token source (everything above is generated from it) |
| [`project/downloads/kilowott-logo.svg`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-logo.svg) | Wordmark, vector |
| [`project/assets/kilowott-bolt.jpg`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/assets/kilowott-bolt.jpg) | Bolt mark, 100×100 JPG only (see §8) |
| [`project/downloads/kilowott-colors.ase`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.ase) | Adobe swatches (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) |
| [`project/downloads/kilowott-colors.gpl`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.gpl) | GIMP / Inkscape / Krita palette |
| [`project/downloads/kilowott-colors.json`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-colors.json) | Swatches as JSON (hex, RGB, role) |
| [`project/downloads/kilowott-deck-template.pptx`](https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-deck-template.pptx) | PowerPoint template, 15 slides |
| [`prompts/`](https://github.com/zoeytad/kilowott-design-system/tree/main/prompts) | Ready-to-paste prompts: `claude-code.md`, `claude-design.md`, `cowork.md`, `web-builders.md` |

## 5. Getting the tokens in your format

<!-- tokens:start variant=compact -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/build-tokens.mjs from project/styles/tokens.css. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run build:tokens`. -->

### Brand colours

| Token | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--k-ink` | `#0B0F14` | near-black, primary text, hero backgrounds |
| `--k-ink-2` | `#1A2230` | secondary surface dark |
| `--k-ink-3` | `#2B3544` | tertiary, borders on dark |
| `--k-paper` | `#FFFFFF` | primary surface |
| `--k-paper-2` | `#F6F4F0` | warm off-white, section breaks |
| `--k-paper-3` | `#EDEAE3` | warmer still, cards on paper |
| `--k-red` | `#E4022D` | signature — use sparingly |
| `--k-red-soft` | `#FCE5EA` | tinted bg for red accents |
| `--k-red-ink` | `#8A021B` | darkened red for text on paper |
| `--k-rule` | `#1A2230` | rules/borders on paper |
| `--k-rule-soft` | `#E2DED6` | soft divider on paper |
| `--k-muted` | `#5B6573` | secondary text on paper |
| `--k-muted-dark` | `#8A95A5` | secondary text on ink |
| `--k-red-hover` | `#B40224` | pressed / hover state for red fills |

### State colours (product UI only, never marketing)

| Token | Hex | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `--k-success` | `#1A7F35` | success text, icons, dots · 5.1:1 on paper |
| `--k-success-soft` | `#E8F3EB` | success tint (badge / banner background) |
| `--k-warning` | `#9A6200` | warning text, icons, dots · 5.1:1 on paper |
| `--k-warning-soft` | `#FBF1E0` | warning tint (badge / banner background) |
| `--k-info` | `#1A4E8A` | info text, icons, dots · 8.4:1 on paper |
| `--k-info-soft` | `#E6EDF5` | info tint (badge / banner background) |

### Semantic tokens (use these in CSS; they switch with the theme)

| Token | Light (default) | Dark (`[data-theme="dark"]`) | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bg` | `#FFFFFF` (`--k-paper`) | `#0B0F14` (`--k-ink`) | page background |
| `--bg-2` | `#F6F4F0` (`--k-paper-2`) | `#1A2230` (`--k-ink-2`) | warm paper: section breaks, cards on paper |
| `--bg-3` | `#EDEAE3` (`--k-paper-3`) | `#2B3544` (`--k-ink-3`) | warmer card on paper |
| `--fg` | `#0B0F14` (`--k-ink`) | `#FFFFFF` (`--k-paper`) | primary text |
| `--fg-2` | `#5B6573` (`--k-muted`) | `#8A95A5` (`--k-muted-dark`) | secondary text |
| `--accent` | `#E4022D` (`--k-red`) | `#E4022D` (`--k-red`) | signature red: one spotlight per surface |
| `--accent-ink` | `#8A021B` (`--k-red-ink`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | red for small text on paper |
| `--rule` | `#E2DED6` (`--k-rule-soft`) | `#2B3544` | soft divider |
| `--rule-strong` | `#1A2230` (`--k-rule`) | `#3B4656` | strong rule / button border |
| `--accent-hover` | `#B40224` (`--k-red-hover`) | `#B40224` (`--k-red-hover`) | hover / pressed state for red fills |
| `--success` | `#1A7F35` (`--k-success`) | `#5BC27A` | state: success (product UI only) |
| `--success-soft` | `#E8F3EB` (`--k-success-soft`) | `rgba(91,194,122,0.12)` | state: success tint |
| `--warning` | `#9A6200` (`--k-warning`) | `#E0A43A` | state: warning (product UI only) |
| `--warning-soft` | `#FBF1E0` (`--k-warning-soft`) | `rgba(224,164,58,0.12)` | state: warning tint |
| `--info` | `#1A4E8A` (`--k-info`) | `#7FA8E0` | state: info (product UI only) |
| `--info-soft` | `#E6EDF5` (`--k-info-soft`) | `rgba(127,168,224,0.12)` | state: info tint |
| `--danger` | `#E4022D` (`--accent`) | `#E4022D` (`--accent`) | state: danger = brand red |
| `--danger-soft` | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--k-red-soft`) | state: danger tint |
| `--link` | `#8A021B` (`--accent-ink`) | `#FCE5EA` (`--accent-ink`) | text links, inline code, small red text |

**Fonts:** `--font-display` "Newsreader", ui-serif, Georgia, serif · `--font-sans` "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif · `--font-mono` "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

**Spacing (8pt):** `--s-0` 0 · `--s-1` 4px · `--s-2` 8px · `--s-3` 12px · `--s-4` 16px · `--s-5` 24px · `--s-6` 32px · `--s-7` 48px · `--s-8` 64px · `--s-9` 96px · `--s-10` 128px

**Radii:** `--r-0` 0 · `--r-1` 2px · `--r-2` 4px · `--r-3` 8px · `--r-4` 12px · `--r-pill` 999px

Full tables (type scale, shadows, motion, contrast): https://brandkit.kilowott.com/KILOWOTT_BRAND.md#2-tokens
<!-- tokens:end -->

| You use… | Do this |
|---|---|
| Plain HTML / any framework | `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css">` then `var(--bg)`, `var(--fg)`, `var(--accent)`, `var(--s-5)` |
| Tailwind v3 | download `project/kit/tokens.tailwind.js`, then `presets: [require('./tokens.tailwind.js')]`. Classes: `bg-bg text-fg text-fg-2 border-rule text-link bg-accent font-display text-d1 p-s-5 rounded-pill shadow-k-2`, brand hex as `bg-k-paper-2` |
| Tailwind v4 | `@import "tailwindcss"; @import "https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css"; @import "https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/tokens.tailwind.css";` (or copy both files locally) |
| Sass | `@use "tokens"` with `project/kit/tokens.scss` (`$k-ink`, `$bg`, `$s-5`, maps `$kilowott-theme-light/-dark`) |
| JS / design-token tooling (Style Dictionary, etc.) | `fetch('https://brandkit.kilowott.com/tokens.json')`: DTCG `$value`/`$type`, aliases like `{color.brand.paper}`, dark overrides under `theme.dark` |
| Resolved values, no aliases | `project/brand.json` → `tokens` (hex for light and dark, contrast ratios) |
| Figma | import `project/kit/figma-tokens.json` with Tokens Studio; swatches via `kilowott-colors.ase` |
| Dark theme | `<html data-theme="dark">` with kilowott.css; or wrap a band in `.section--ink` |

## 6. Page index: the 22 pages

Live: `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/#<id>` · Source: `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/<id>.js`

The sidebar groups the pages by task: **Start** (Home, Downloads) · **Brand basics** (Logo, Colour, Type, Imagery, Voice) · **Make something** (Social media, Posters & ads, Presentations, Email & newsletters, Email signature, Print & stationery, Case studies & editorial) · **Build for web** (Foundations, Components, Icons, Landing pages, Dashboards, Developers & AI). Every page opens with a “Rules at a glance” do / never box. Deep links: `#<id>/<element-id>`.

| Tab (`#id`) | What it contains | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| Home (`#overview`) | Search, eight task tiles, the brand in 60 seconds, most-used files, four principles | Orientation |
| Downloads (`#downloads`) | Every file in one place: logo, swatches, deck template, starter page, CSS, Tailwind, Sass, tokens, Figma tokens, AI files | Getting a file |
| Developers & AI (`#developers`) | Copy-paste prompt for AI tools, tokens by format, machine-readable files | Briefing an AI tool, wiring tokens into code |
| Logo (`#logo`) | Wordmark anatomy, bolt mark, clear space and sizes, placements, CSS-mask implementation, don’ts | Placing the logo anywhere |
| Color (`#color`) | Core palette, 60·30·5·5, alt accents, three recipes (paper, ink, warm), red rules, accessibility table, state colours | Any colour decision |
| Type (`#type`) | Newsreader + DM Sans pairing, 9-step scale, headline patterns, JetBrains Mono usage | Setting type |
| Foundations (`#foundations`) | 8pt spacing, 12-column grid, radii, elevation, motion, full token dump | Layout and spacing |
| Icons (`#icons`) | Lucide rules, usage, sizes, 69-icon curated starter set in 6 categories | Choosing icons |
| Components (`#components`) | Buttons, badges, eyebrows, forms, cards, stat and case cards, tabs, breadcrumbs, UI states, modal, toast, tooltip, accordion, dropdown, avatar, alert, pagination, table, top nav, footer, search (`.k-*`) | Any UI element |
| Landing (`#landing`) | 6 hero patterns (editorial, stat-led, image-right, full-bleed, proof, video-poster) + 4 sections (three-up, feature split, stat strip, final CTA), house rules | Landing pages and websites |
| Dashboards (`#dashboards`) | Rules for dense surfaces, KPI tiles, deltas, sparklines, tables, meters, toolbars, spreadsheet, OHLC, tree grid, waterfall, heatmap, forecast, full shell (`.db-*`) | Product UI, analytics |
| Deck (`#deck`) | 15 slide layouts, four deck rules, canvas specs, .pptx template | Presentations |
| Email (`#email`) | Five email rules, receipt, welcome, quarterly newsletter, specs (600px, inline styles) | HTML email |
| Signature (`#signature`) | Generator with 3 layouts, copies Gmail-ready HTML | Email signatures |
| Newsletter (`#newsletter`) | Block composer (11 blocks), exports email-safe HTML or plain text | Newsletters |
| Stationery (`#stationery`) | Business card, letterhead, compliments slip, envelope, notebook, folder, sticker; print specs | Print |
| Case study (`#case-study`) | Seven rules, full rendered template, checklist | Case studies |
| Magazine (`#magazine`) | Framework cover, article spreads, five pillars, print specs | Editorial long-form |
| Imagery (`#imagery`) | Four principles, five categories, grades, crops, mistakes, placeholders, approved library, sourcing | Choosing or treating photos |
| Voice (`#voice`) | Principles, service lines, tone dial, registers, before/after, vocab, mechanics, length ladder | Writing anything |
| Social media (`#social`) | Where to post (LinkedIn first), six post types with copy formulas (proof, point of view, people, hiring, event, end card), LinkedIn document carousel, post editor with PNG export, feed previews for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, profile kit | Any social post |
| Posters & banners (`#posters`) | Print posters (A3/A2/A1/18×24in), roll-up 850×2000mm, backdrop, 48-sheet billboard, flyer, event badge; IAB display ads, Meta/LinkedIn ad set, OG 1200×630, YouTube thumbnail, email hero; 4 archetypes (Statement, Stat, Photo-led, Event) | Posters, ads, banners, OG images |

## 7. Starter page (copy, paste, edit)

A fuller version with nav, stats, services, case card, and footer: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/starter/index.html

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Nordhavn Coffee × Kilowott — demo page</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400;1,6..72,500&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css">
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.66.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js" defer></script>
</head>
<body>
  <!-- Demo content: Nordhavn Coffee and its figures are fictional sample data. -->
  <header class="k-nav">
    <div class="k-nav__inner">
      <a href="/" class="k-logo" aria-label="Kilowott"></a>
      <ul class="k-nav__links">
        <li><a href="#work">Work</a></li>
        <li><a href="#services">Services</a></li>
      </ul>
      <a class="btn btn--primary btn--sm" href="https://kilowott.com/contact-us/">Talk to us</a>
    </div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <section class="k-hero">
      <div class="container">
        <span class="eyebrow">Kilowott for Brands</span>
        <h1 class="display">A US launch that <em>compounds</em>.</h1>
        <p class="lede">Nordhavn Coffee came to the US with a strong product and no search footprint. Six months of SEO and paid social later, organic traffic is up 3.5×.</p>
        <div class="k-hero__actions">
          <a class="btn btn--primary" href="#work">Read the case <i data-lucide="arrow-right" class="btn__arrow"></i></a>
          <a class="btn btn--ghost" href="https://kilowott.com/contact-us/">Start a project</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="section section--warm" id="work">
      <div class="container grid grid-3">
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat__num">3.5×</div><div class="stat__label">organic traffic</div><div class="stat__source">Sample figure · 6 months</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat__num">−21%</div><div class="stat__label">cost per acquisition</div><div class="stat__source">Sample figure · 6 months</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat__num">58</div><div class="stat__label">page-one keywords</div><div class="stat__source">Sample figure · 6 months</div></div>
      </div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="k-footer">
    <div class="container">Fredrikstad · Sandnes · Goa · Dubai · <a href="https://kilowott.com">kilowott.com</a></div>
  </footer>
  <script>addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => window.lucide && lucide.createIcons());</script>
</body>
</html>
```

One red moment: the italic *compounds*. The CTA is ink, the stats are ink. If you add a red button, take the red off the headline word.

---

## 8. Known gaps

- **Bolt mark is raster only:** `project/assets/kilowott-bolt.jpg`, 100×100 JPG. There is no vector bolt. Don’t trace, redraw, or upscale it into a fake vector; use the wordmark, or ask the Kilowott brand team for the master file.
- **Fonts are Google Fonts only**: no self-hosted font files in the kit.
- **Print colour** is specified on the Stationery tab (red CMYK 0/100/87/5, nearest Pantone 186 C); there is no Pantone-licensed swatch book. The `.ase` file is RGB.
- **The live site needs JavaScript.** Use the text files for reading; use the browser for looking.

---

## 9. Checklist before you hand anything back

1. Background is paper (or warm paper). Text is ink. It looks calm.
2. Count the reds: exactly one red moment. Links and small red text use `--link`.
3. Headlines are Newsreader 400 with at most one italic word. Body is DM Sans. Numbers in columns are tabular.
4. Tokens only (except email/print/swatches). Works with `data-theme="dark"` if it is a product surface.
5. Copy passes voice: no exclamation marks, no banned words, sentence case, numbers sourced.
6. All people, clients, quotes, and numbers are fictional (Nordhavn Coffee, Ola Nordmann) unless they are Kilowott company facts.
7. Icons are Lucide at 1.5 stroke. Logo is the SVG wordmark with clear space.
8. Focus states are visible; contrast is AA (see the contrast table in `KILOWOTT_BRAND.md` §2).

---

## 10. Working on this repo (agents editing the kit itself)

- Static SPA, no build step for the site: `project/index.html` + `project/app.js` (hash router) + `project/pages/<tab>.js` (each defines `window.render<Tab>(root)`) + `project/styles/tokens.css` + `project/styles/shell.css`.
- Run locally: `python3 -m http.server 8723` from the repo root, open http://localhost:8723/project/.
- **Tokens:** edit only `project/styles/tokens.css`, then `npm run build:tokens`. Never hand-edit generated files (`tokens.json`, `llms-full.txt`, `project/kit/*` except `starter/`, the `tokens` key in `project/brand.json`, `<!-- tokens:start -->` blocks, `project/downloads/kilowott-colors.*`, `project/downloads/kilowott-logo.svg`).
- **Before pushing:** `npm run check` (syntax, generated files in sync, contrast claims, manifest vs router, links, escape bugs). CI runs the same on every push and PR.
- Inside template strings, CSS escapes must be doubled: write `\\201C`, not `\201C`.
- Push to `main` deploys to https://brandkit.kilowott.com (Railway). See `DEPLOY.md`.


========================================================================
FILE: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/KILOWOTT_BRAND.md
(Brand reference: principles, tokens, type, logo, imagery, voice)
========================================================================

# Kilowott brand reference — v1.0

Compact brand reference for people and AI agents. Live kit: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/ · Agent guide: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/AGENTS.md · Source of truth for tokens: `project/styles/tokens.css` (the tables in §2 are generated from it).

> **Tagline:** *Ahead, by design.* · **Long form:** *We build ahead so you can scale faster, deliver better and create impact.* · Middle line (5–8 words): not decided yet; leave a placeholder.
> Kilowott is a strategic partner that turns strategy and execution into measurable outcomes: margins protected, speed gained, delivery you can rely on.

---

## 1. Brand principles

1. **Calm by default.** Generous whitespace, narrow palette. Type does the heavy lifting. Noise is a design failure.
2. **Red earns its place.** Signature red is a spotlight, not a wash. One idea per surface: a stat, a verb, or a CTA.
3. **Editorial over ornamental.** Serif display + clean sans. Italics carry emphasis. No gradients, glows, or filler icons.
4. **Technical and human.** Built with engineers, for enterprise, written like people. Precise, never sterile. Confident, never loud.

---

## 2. Tokens

Use the CSS custom properties, never raw hex, in CSS. Prefer the **semantic** tokens (`--bg`, `--fg`, `--accent`, `--link`, …) because they switch with the theme. The fastest way to get all of them is one stylesheet: `https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css`.

### Spacing, radii, elevation, motion, layout

- **Spacing (8pt base):** `--s-0` 0 · `--s-1` 4px · `--s-2` 8px · `--s-3` 12px · `--s-4` 16px · `--s-5` 24px · `--s-6` 32px · `--s-7` 48px · `--s-8` 64px · `--s-9` 96px · `--s-10` 128px
- **Radii:** `--r-0` 0 · `--r-1` 2px · `--r-2` 4px · `--r-3` 8px · `--r-4` 12px · `--r-pill` 999px
- `--shadow-0`: `none`
- `--shadow-1`: `0 1px 0 rgba(11,15,20,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(11,15,20,0.04)`
- `--shadow-2`: `0 2px 4px rgba(11,15,20,0.06), 0 8px 16px rgba(11,15,20,0.06)`
- `--shadow-3`: `0 4px 8px rgba(11,15,20,0.08), 0 24px 48px rgba(11,15,20,0.10)`
- **Motion:** `--ease-standard` cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) · `--ease-in` cubic-bezier(.4, 0, 1, 1) · `--ease-out` cubic-bezier(0, 0, .2, 1) · `--dur-fast` 120ms · `--dur-standard` 200ms · `--dur-slow` 320ms
- **Layout:** `--container` 1280px · `--gutter` 32px
- **Dark theme** also overrides: `--shadow-1`, `--shadow-2`, `--shadow-3` (deeper shadows).
<!-- tokens:end -->

### Usage ratio

**60 · 30 · 5 · 5 = paper · ink · warm paper · red.** Paper (`--k-paper`) carries the page, ink (`--k-ink`) holds the type and the occasional dark band, warm paper (`--k-paper-2`) separates sections, red (`--k-red`) is the single spotlight. Never invert it: the brand is paper-led, not ink-led.

### Red rules

1. One red idea per surface: the italic emphasis word in a headline, one stat, the primary CTA, or a thin 1–2px rule. Pick one.
2. Never red body text. Small red text (links, inline code, labels) uses `--link` (= `--accent-ink`, red-ink #8A021B, 10:1 on paper). Brand red is only 4.8:1 on paper and fails on warm paper.
3. Red buttons only for the primary conversion. Everything else is ink or outline.
4. Never tint, gradient, or two-tone red. Never a red background wash or full red section.
5. Never next to another saturated colour.
6. State colours (`--success`, `--warning`, `--info`) are for product UI only, always with an icon and a word. Danger is brand red.

### Alt accents (campaign / sub-brand only)

They **replace** red as the single accent, never sit beside it: Deeper Red `#C8102E` (editorial, print) · Signal Orange `#F05A28` (Workforce; 3.4:1, large type only) · Electric Blue `#1F3CFF` (Intelligence, product) · Ink Mono `#0B0F14`. Default is Kilowott Red `#E4022D`.

---

## 3. Typography

Exactly three webfonts. System fallbacks only.

- **Display (serif):** Newsreader, roman + italic, weights 400/500, optical size 6–72. Headlines, stats, pull quotes. Never below 20px.
- **Sans (UI and body):** DM Sans, 400/500. Body, UI, buttons, eyebrows. Minimum 12px.
- **Mono:** JetBrains Mono, 400/500. Tokens, hex values, folios, table numerals, meta. Never for prose, CTAs, or stat numerals.

Google Fonts (one line):

```html
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400;1,6..72,500&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
```

**Rules**

- Display headlines: Newsreader 400 (not bold), line-height 1.04, tracking −0.02em. One word per headline in `<em>`: italic and red. Only one.
- UI headings (h1–h3 in product surfaces): DM Sans 500.
- Body: DM Sans 16px, line-height 1.55, colour `--fg`, measure 58–64ch.
- Eyebrow: DM Sans 12px caps, tracking 0.18em, 24px leading tick in `currentColor`, max four words. `.eyebrow--accent` makes it red, and then it is the surface's red moment.
- Numbers in columns: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, right-aligned.
- Headline patterns: italic emphasis · eyebrow + headline · numeric lead (“14× …”).

---

## 4. Spacing, layout, radii, elevation, motion

- **8pt spacing** (`--s-1` 4px … `--s-10` 128px). Sections are 96px apart (`--s-9`); tight sections 48px (`--s-7`).
- **Layout:** container 1280px, gutter 32px, 12-column grid (4 on mobile), content max 10 columns. Breakpoints 600 / 900 / 1200 / 1440. `grid-2/3/4/6` collapse below 900px.
- **Radii:** 0 · 2 · 4 · 8 (cards, images) · 12 · pill (buttons, chips). Almost nothing else is rounded.
- **Elevation:** no shadow by default; `--shadow-1` hover baseline, `--shadow-2` elevated card or framed image, `--shadow-3` modals only. Dark theme deepens shadows.
- **Motion:** standard 200ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`; fast 120ms; slow 320ms. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

---

## 5. Component primitives (in `kilowott.css`)

- **`.btn`** pill, transparent, 1px border, hover inverts. `.btn--primary` (ink fill, hover red), `.btn--accent` (red fill, conversion only, hover `--accent-hover`), `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--sm`, `.btn--lg`. Arrow slides right on hover. Never two accent buttons in one view. Focus ring 2px at 3px offset.
- **`.chip`** pill, 1px rule, uppercase 12px, muted.
- **`.card`** paper, 1px rule, 8px radius, 32px padding. `.card--warm`, `.card--link`.
- **`.eyebrow`**, **`.eyebrow--accent`** as above.
- **`.display`** serif display; `em` inside goes italic red. Sizes `.display--d1/d2/d3`.
- **`.stat`** (`.stat__num`, `.stat__label`, `.stat__source`) one serif number, one line, one mono source line.
- **`.section`**, `.section--tight`, `.section--warm`, `.section--ink`; `.container`; `.grid-2/3/4/6`; `.two-col`; `.rule`.
- **`.k-nav`**, **`.k-hero`**, **`.k-footer`**, **`.k-logo`** for quick pages.

The full parts bin (forms, badges, tabs, modals, toasts, tables, states, pagination) lives on the Components tab with class prefix `.k-*`.

---

## 6. Icons

**Lucide** (lucide.dev, 1,500+ icons, ISC licence), pinned to `lucide@1.66.0`:

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.66.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
<i data-lucide="arrow-right"></i>
<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
```

Spec: 24×24, stroke 1.5 (1.25 at 48px), round caps, `currentColor`. Sizes 16 · 20 · **24** · 32 · 48. Accent colour is for state only (hover, active, alert). Interactive hit area at least 36×36px. Never hand-draw an icon. The Icons tab shows a house-curated starter set of 69 icons in six categories (navigation, action, status, finance, social, misc).

---

## 7. Logo

- **Wordmark (primary):** `project/assets/kilowott-logo.svg` (viewBox `0 0 313 41`). Download: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/downloads/kilowott-logo.svg. One SVG on every surface, recoloured with a CSS mask and `currentColor`:

```css
.k-logo { width: 110px; height: 18px; aspect-ratio: 313 / 41; background: currentColor;
  -webkit-mask: url(assets/kilowott-logo.svg) no-repeat center / contain;
          mask: url(assets/kilowott-logo.svg) no-repeat center / contain; }
```

- **Clear space** = height of the K on all sides. **Sizes:** hero ≥240px / 60mm, standard 120–240px, minimum 80px / 20mm (below that, use the bolt).
- **Placements:** paper (default), ink, warm paper, red (rare). Never stretch, rotate, add shadows, or place on busy images. Never redraw or re-typeset.
- **Bolt mark (companion):** `project/assets/kilowott-bolt.jpg`, black bolt on white. Avatars, favicons, app icons, watermarks. Never replaces the wordmark where the wordmark fits. Black on white or white on ink only (`filter: invert(1)`); never red, gradient, or two-tone. **Known gap:** the bolt exists only as a 100×100 JPG. There is no vector. Don't trace or fake one; ask the Kilowott brand team.

---

## 8. Imagery

Imagery puts the work in a room. Editorial, not stock.

1. **Real over rendered.** No AI-generated imagery in external work. No glowing “AI” renders or blue grids.
2. **Human gaze.** Real hands, real screens, real sites. No handshakes, no stock smiles, no people lined up against a wall.
3. **Warm, not saturated.** House grade: desaturate slightly, warm slightly. Brand red only when it is already in the frame.
4. **Space for type.** One subject, one idea. Leave room for the headline.

- **Treatments:** house grade (default) · ink/paper duotone for heroes and section covers only · warm mono. Grain 1–3% fine; no filters, vignettes, or gradient overlays.
- **Crops:** 16:9 (hero, case study) · 21:9 (full-bleed hero) · 3:2 · 4:5 (portrait, social) · 1:1 (grids) · 9:16 (stories, reels).
- **Framing:** 8px radius by default, 0 for edge-to-edge heroes, 1px `--rule` border when the image matches the surface tone. On paper with body copy, sit photos in a warm-paper section.
- **Library:** cleared images in `project/assets/photos/`. The Shutterstock originals in `project/uploads/` are licensed stock for Kilowott use only: internal reference library, do not redistribute.

---

## 9. Voice

### Principles

1. **Outcome-driven.** Measurable results, not activity. Every claim lands on ROI, growth, delivery, or a number you can check.
2. **Strategic and specific.** Partner in the room, not vendor at the door. Name the industry, the tool, the region, the number.
3. **Confident, not loud.** No “may”, “could”, “potentially”. No exclamation marks. The work carries the weight.
4. **Human, not corporate.** Write to a person. Contractions and first person are fine. Senior-partner tone.

### Where we sit on the dial

Formal → **plainspoken** (82%) · Cautious → **direct** (76%) · Activity → **outcomes** (90%) · Vendor → **partner** (86%) · Abstract → **concrete** (86%).

### Service lines (always name the service)

- **Kilowott for Brands** — full operational ownership, measured in ROI
- **Kilowott for Agencies** — white-label and agency partnership
- **Kilowott Intelligence** — the AI offering: smart systems with human oversight
- **Kilowott Workforce** — cross-functional team build-outs

### Vocabulary

- **Use:** partner · deliver / ship · measurable · outcome / ROI · ownership · team / specialists · build · help / support · use
- **Avoid:** leverage · empower · unlock · synergy · best-in-class · cutting-edge · at scale · seamless · end-to-end · tailored solutions · excited to announce · revolutionary / game-changing · transformative · world-class

When in doubt, the left column wins.

### Mechanics (house style)

- **Punctuation:** Oxford comma · em dash unspaced (`word—word`) · semicolons almost never · **no exclamation marks** · curly quotes and apostrophes always · sentence case for titles and buttons.
- **Numbers:** spell out one to nine, numerals for 10 and up · `6%` not “6 percent” · `$4.2M` not `$4,200,000` · en dash for ranges `6–9` · every stat cites a source and a time window.
- **Names:** Kilowott is one word · product names in title case, no “The” · spell out acronyms on first use · lowercase job titles in running text.

### Length ladder

| Length | Format |
|---|---|
| 4–9 words | Website hero line (three-beat taglines by default) |
| 10–14 words | Deck headline (one sentence per slide, argument first) |
| 25–40 words | Subhead / lede |
| under 15 words | Product UI string |
| 60–120 words | Social / LinkedIn post |
| 250–400 words | Service blurb |
| 600–900 words | Case study (situation → decision → result) |
| 1,200–1,800 words | POV / essay (bylined) |

### Register by context

| Context | Tone | Length |
|---|---|---|
| Sales deck | Confident, partner register | 10–14 words per headline |
| Website hero | Sharp, thesis first | 4–9 words |
| Case study | Narrative, ROI-specific | 600–900 words |
| Product UI | Instructive, forgiving | under 15 words per string |
| Social / LinkedIn | Partnered, proof-led | 60–120 words |
| Internal / Slack | Casual, precise | 2–4 lines |

### The same idea, twice

- **Don’t:** “Leveraging cutting-edge AI solutions to empower enterprise transformation at scale.”
  **Do:** “Kilowott Intelligence pairs smart systems with human oversight, so the workflow scales and the outcome stays accountable.”
- **Don’t:** “We drove significant growth through targeted marketing.”
  **Do:** “Organic traffic up 3.5× for Nordhavn Coffee in six months.” *(fictional sample figure)*
- **Don’t:** “We are excited to announce a strategic partnership!”
  **Do:** “A new engagement, starting today—Kilowott Workforce is standing up a cross-functional team with a Nordic logistics partner. First release in Q3.”

---

## 10. Facts: real vs fictional

**Company facts (real, use as-is):** Kilowott · https://kilowott.com · contact page https://kilowott.com/contact-us/ · offices Fredrikstad · Sandnes · Goa · Dubai · company phone lines and socials as listed in `project/brand.json` → `facts`.

**Demo content (fictional, always):** everything shown as an example in the kit is dummy data. The shared demo client is **Nordhavn Coffee** (specialty coffee, US launch, SEO + paid social, 3.5× organic traffic in six months — sample figures; domain `nordhavn-coffee.example`). The placeholder person is **Ola Nordmann**, Senior Strategist, ola.nordmann@kilowott.com, +47 000 00 000. Other fictional clients already in the kit (Nordic Freight, Meridian Health, …) are fine. Never use real third-party people, companies, testimonials, logos, or personal booking links in demo content.

========================================================================
FILE: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/llms.txt
(Build spec: render recipe, component and pattern specs, facts)
========================================================================

# Kilowott build spec for AI agents — v1.0

> Editorial brand register. Calm by default. Red earns its place.
> This is the detailed build spec: render recipe, common mistakes, component specs, and pattern specs for every surface in the kit.
> Start with the agent guide (https://brandkit.kilowott.com/AGENTS.md) if you haven't. Everything in one file: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/llms-full.txt

Live kit: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/ · Page sources: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/<tab>.js · Drop-in stylesheet: https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css

---

## Read this first

The kit is a single-page app. Fetching `index.html` returns empty page divs because content is rendered by JavaScript. Use this file, `brand.json` (same folder), `../tokens.json`, and the page sources in `pages/*.js` as the source of truth, not the rendered HTML.

When asked to “match the Kilowott brand”, produce something that:

- sits on a **white paper background** (`#FFFFFF`) by default, not dark;
- uses **Newsreader** for headlines, **DM Sans** for body and UI, **JetBrains Mono** for system labels;
- puts **one** italic emphasis word per headline in **red `#E4022D`**, and no other red on that surface;
- keeps red to about **5%** of the visible area: never a background, never body text;
- has no gradients, glows, neon, vaporwave, stock handshakes, or AI-generated imagery.

---

## Render recipe

1. `<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/kit/kilowott.css">` (fonts, tokens, base, primitives). Or copy the tokens from `../tokens.json`.
2. Body: `background: var(--bg)` (#FFFFFF), `color: var(--fg)` (#0B0F14), DM Sans 16px, line-height 1.55.
3. Headlines: `.display` (Newsreader 400, line-height 1.04, tracking −0.02em). Sizes `--fs-d1` hero, `--fs-d2` page title, `--fs-d3` section.
4. One word per headline in `<em>`: italic + `var(--accent)`.
5. Eyebrows: `.eyebrow` (DM Sans 12px caps, 0.18em, 24px tick in currentColor), max four words.
6. Buttons: `.btn` pill, 14px DM Sans 500. `.btn--primary` = ink fill (default CTA). `.btn--accent` = red fill, only for the primary conversion and only if nothing else on the surface is red.
7. Sections 96px apart (`.section`). Breaks via warm paper (`.section--warm`), dark bands via `.section--ink`. Never red.
8. Icons: Lucide `lucide@1.66.0`, stroke 1.5, 24px default, `currentColor`.
9. Links and small red text: `var(--link)` (red-ink #8A021B).

If your output looks neon, dark by default, gradient-heavy, or has more than one red word, it is wrong.

---

## Common AI mistakes

1. **Making the page dark.** The topbar is white with a black wordmark. Light is the default.
2. **Making things red because the brand is “red”.** Red is one spotlight. `--fg` is ink, not red. Red lives only in `--accent`.
3. **Every italic in red.** Only the headline emphasis word. Italic in body copy stays `--fg` or `--fg-2`.
4. **Bold serif headlines.** Newsreader is set at 400. The serif does the work.
5. **Brand red for links.** Use `--link` (red-ink). Brand red fails AA on warm paper.
6. **Two red moments** (red word + red button + red stat). Pick one.
7. **Inventing facts.** Don’t invent offices, clients, awards, people, or numbers. Demo content uses Nordhavn Coffee and Ola Nordmann.
8. **Hand-drawn icons or emoji.** Use Lucide.
9. **Green for positive deltas** in dashboards. Up = ink, down = red.

---

## Tokens

(Token tables: identical to the full tables in the KILOWOTT_BRAND.md section above.)

---

## Component specs (Components tab, prefix `.k-*`; kit primitives in `kit/kilowott.css`)

- **Buttons** — 4 variants (primary ink, accent red, secondary outline, ghost) × sm/md/lg. Pill radius. Never two accent buttons in one view. Focus ring 2px accent at 3px offset. Arrow icon nudges 3px right on hover.
- **Badges and eyebrows** — eyebrow ALL CAPS, 0.18em, max four words. Status badges show a dot; taxonomy tags don’t.
- **Form fields** — label above in caps; focus = accent border + 3px ring at 12%; checkbox hit area 18px; switch only for instant-apply settings.
- **Cards** — paper, 1px `--rule`, 8px radius, 32px padding. Stat card: one serif number, one line, one mono source line. Case card: 4:3 photo, two meta pills, serif title with italic accent, arrow CTA.
- **Tabs** — max five. Underline variant for long filtering lists. **Breadcrumb** only 3+ levels deep.
- **UI states** — empty (one italic accent word, one action, no sad faces), error (name the failure, give a reference code, retry first), skeleton (shape matches content, 1.4s pulse, respects reduced motion), spinner (rarely; skeletons are the default), success, 404 (the italic 0 is the accent moment).
- **Modal** — destructive dialogs: Cancel has default focus. `--shadow-3`.
- **Toast** — 3px rail. **Tooltip** — max four words. **Alert banner** — one at a time.
- **Avatar** — 28 / 40 / 56px. **Pagination** — first, last, and three around current.
- **Top nav** — max five links + one CTA; goes solid after 80px scroll. **Footer** — three columns.
- **House rules** — check the Components tab before inventing a component; one accent per view; works in light, dark, compact, and spacious; focus outlines are non-negotiable.

---

## Pattern specs by surface

### Landing (`#landing`, prefix `.lp-*`)
House rules: one accent moment (italic red word or red button); hero 4–9 words, lede ≤40 words; container 1280px, content ≤64ch; ≥96px between sections; every claim paired with proof; red CTA only for conversion, otherwise ink.
Patterns: 01 editorial hero · 02 stat-led hero (figure ~40% width) · 03 image-right hero (55/45) · 04 full-bleed atmospheric (scrim 40→85%) · 05 proof hero (six wordmarks, fictional) · 06 video-poster hero · 07 three-up value prop · 08 feature split (50/50) · 09 stat strip band (once per page) · 10 final CTA block.

### Dashboards (`#dashboards`, prefixes `.db-*`, `.kpi`, `.ss-*`, `.ohlc`, `.tree`, `.waterfall`, `.heatmap`, `.fc`)
Rules: one serif number per tile; tabular numerals in columns; red only for losses and alerts; positive deltas in ink, not green; 12–16px tile padding and gaps; every number has a time window.
Parts: KPI tiles, deltas, sparklines (32px, 1.25px stroke), data tables (right-aligned mono numerals), status dots, meters (4px), alerts, toolbars (search left, scope centre, primary action right), spreadsheet grid, OHLC (up ink, down accent), tree grid, waterfall (losses accent), heatmap (the only place red fills large areas: severity is the point), forecast and scenarios, full shell (paper sidebar, ink tick for active page).

### Deck (`#deck`, prefix `.dk-*`; template `downloads/kilowott-deck-template.pptx`)
Canvas 1920×1080 (16:9), 56px outer margin, one red per slide, never bullet lists, dark slides are for breaks.
Specs: logo 48px from top, 56px from left, 18–22px high; page number mono 12px; cover headline 100–140px; content headline 60–84px; eyebrow 14px at 0.22em; body 17–18px; deck headlines 10–14 words.
15 layouts: title · section divider (ink) · content 2-col · stat (240–320px number) · quote (<20 words) · full-bleed image · closing CTA · agenda (≤5 items) · team · timeline · pricing (3 tiers, ≤5 features) · comparison (5 rows) · logo wall (5×2, fictional marks) · chart (≤2 series) · thank you.

### Email (`#email`, prefix `.em-*`)
Five rules: 600px single column in nested tables; one headline, one button, one CTA; Georgia/Arial fallbacks, red only on the italic word and the legal line; preheader 40–90 characters; plain-text version, unsubscribe, and postal address, mono for data rows.
Specs: padding 40/40/32; headline 34px/1.1; body 16px/1.6 `#1A2230`; button 14px, padding 14×28, radius 999px; logo 120×18px; subject under 55 characters; no emoji in transactional mail; forced light mode. **Email HTML must use inline styles and hex values** (no CSS variables, no external stylesheet).

### Newsletter (`#newsletter`, prefix `.nl-*`)
Block composer on a 600px canvas; 11 blocks (eyebrow, heading, sub-heading, paragraph, image, video poster, button ink/accent/outline, divider, quote, stat, spacer); header fields subject, preheader (40–90 chars), issue eyebrow, from, address; exports email-safe HTML or plain text for Gmail. Quarterly note: 3–4 stories of 60–100 words.

### Signature (`#signature`, prefix `.sig-*`)
Generator with three layouts (Classic, Compact, Editorial); table HTML, inline styles, Georgia/Arial fallbacks, no tracking pixels; square photo ≥144px; fill → copy → paste into Gmail Settings → Signature. Defaults use Ola Nordmann.

### Stationery (`#stationery`, prefix `.st-*`)
Business card 88×54mm, 350gsm uncoated, 3mm bleed, 4mm red right-edge rule · letterhead A4 210×297mm, 100gsm · compliments slip 210×99mm · DL envelope 110×220mm with 4mm red foot rule · A5 notebook · A4 pocket folder · 50mm round sticker.
Print colour: red CMYK 0/100/87/5 (nearest Pantone 186 C); rich black 60/50/50/100. Type: body 10pt, foot 8pt, display 18pt+. Uncoated stock always; deboss the bolt, never foil or spot UV; use the sender’s real office address.

### Case study (`#case-study`, prefix `.cs-*`)
Seven rules: name sector, region, and model; every stat has a source and window; the situation names what wasn’t working; one attributed client quote (fictional in demos); include what didn’t work; team strip; 600–900 words.
Order: header · hero · four outcomes · aside · situation · decision · pull quote · what didn’t work · timeline · result · team · CTA (never “get in touch”). Demo client: Nordhavn Coffee.

### Magazine (`#magazine`, prefix `.mg-*`)
Framework, Kilowott’s own magazine. Trim A4 210×297mm. Cover 300gsm, body 120gsm FSC, perfect-bound; bleed 3mm, safety 5mm; display 30–110pt cover, 22–38pt spreads; body 9–10pt; mono 7–9pt; two-column grid, 24mm gutter. Spreads: opener, profile, by-the-numbers, section divider. Rules: one register; real people and numbers only in live issues (the kit shows fictional ones); photo on the verso, type on the recto.

### Social (`#social`, prefix `.sm-*`; post images drawn by `window.KWPosters`)
LinkedIn first (proof, point of view, document carousels, hiring), Instagram second (people, culture, events), X and Facebook reuse the LinkedIn post. Six post types, each a fixed layout plus a copy formula: **Proof** (Stat archetype: one number, label, source), **Point of view** (Statement: one opinion, one italic phrase), **People and culture** (Photo-led: name and role on the image), **Hiring** (Statement: role and office), **Event** (Event archetype), **End card** (tagline only, last frame of video and carousels). Sizes: 4:5 1080×1350 (default), 1:1, 9:16 1080×1920 (keep type out of the top 250px and bottom 340px), 1.91:1 1200×627. Document carousel: five to eight 4:5 slides as one PDF; cover works alone, one point per slide. Copy: outcome in the first line (before “…more”), every number sourced with a time window, three hashtags at most, no emoji, no exclamation marks, alt text on every image. Organic post images carry no button (the platform adds one). Covers: LinkedIn 1584×396, X 1500×500, Facebook 820×312, tagline only. Avatar: bolt mark. Metrics shown are sample data.

### Posters & banners (`#posters`)
Print: A3, A2, A1, 18×24in posters · roll-up 850×2000mm · event backdrop · 48-sheet billboard · flyer · event badge. Digital: IAB display ads · Meta / LinkedIn ad set · Open Graph 1200×630 · YouTube thumbnail · email hero. Four archetypes: **Statement** (serif headline, one italic red word), **Stat** (one big number), **Photo-led** (real photography, type in clear space), **Event** (date, place, name). The machine-readable spec (sizes, safe areas, type sizes per format) is the JSON in `script#posters-spec` inside https://brandkit.kilowott.com/project/pages/posters.js.

### Imagery (`#imagery`, prefix `.im-*`)
Principles: real over rendered (no AI imagery externally), human gaze, warm not saturated, space for type. Categories: people, environment, product UI (2× retina minimum), abstract / textural, diagrams (1.2px stroke, mono labels 10–12px, 4px radius). Grades: house (desaturate −12, warmth +8), ink/red duotone for heroes, warm mono. Crops: 16:9, 21:9, 3:2, 4:5, 1:1, 9:16. Mistakes to avoid: stock hard hats, AI gradients, people lined up against a wall, sunset handshake, glossy mock-ups, post-it brainstorms. Cleared photos: `assets/photos/`. `uploads/` = licensed Shutterstock originals, internal reference library for Kilowott use only, do not redistribute.

### Logo (`#logo`)
Wordmark SVG via CSS mask + currentColor, 110×18px in a 56px topbar with 16px clear space. Clear space = cap-K height. Hero ≥240px / 60mm, standard 120–240px, minimum 80px / 20mm. Bolt for avatars and favicons (16–1024px) and watermarks (24–48px, 60–80% opacity). The bolt exists only as a 100×100 JPG.

### Voice (`#voice`)
Four principles (outcome-driven; strategic and specific; confident, not loud; human, not corporate), four service lines (Kilowott for Brands, for Agencies, Intelligence, Workforce), the tone dial, registers by context, vocabulary, mechanics, and the length ladder. Full text in KILOWOTT_BRAND.md §9.
